The '''Mission to Uukaablis''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uukaablis]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' traveled to the planet in an attempt to find a cure for a bioweapon deployed by the [[Qektoth Confederation]].
